## ascii-equivalents-keys-are-lookalike-codepoints  (gotcha, verified)
parse.ts ASCII_EQUIVALENTS has keys that render identically but are distinct codepoints; never edit it by eye.

## async-context-carrier-lives-in-globalthis-symbol-slot  (rationale, verified)
The async context carrier is stored in a Symbol.for-keyed globalThis slot, first caller wins, so dual-resolved copies of common share one context.

## build-runs-tsup-before-tsc  (invariant, verified)
Every package's build must be `tsup && tsc`; reversing it lets tsup's clean wipe the tsc-emitted .d.ts files.

- source/*/packages/*/package.json
- source/*/packages/*/tsup.config.ts
- source/core/tsconfig.base.json

## builtin-no-nodejs-modules-still-covers-tests  (gotcha, suspect)
Biome's built-in noNodejsModules is on everywhere via correctness=error, so a node: import in a test still fails lint despite the plugin exemption.

## changed-projects-shared-ci-regex-rejects-hyphens  (gotcha, verified)
changed-projects treats only ci-<letters>.yml as shared CI, so a hyphenated ci-foo-bar.yml change selects no project.

- .github/actions/changed-projects/action.yml
- .github/workflows/ci-*.yml

## integrations-replace-by-name-and-tear-down-newest-first  (invariant, verified)
Reporter integrations are keyed by name in the builder (a repeat replaces in place, which is why there is no realm-wide guard), and close() tears them down newest first, once, before the transport closes.

## redact-walks-error-fields-explicitly  (gotcha, verified)
